New for 2020
PRODUCT INFO
Mixed wheel sizes are the talk of the town! After a lot of testing and processing opinions, we have decided to implement a solution that we truly believe makes a lot of sense for many riders. A big, fast rolling 29” wheel in the front plows through rough terrain, and a smaller 27.5 wheel in the rear is tucked in and allows more suspension travel to be applied without fear of conflicts with the frame or body parts. On timed runs, this setup has proven to be the fastest, especially for smaller riders. Let's not forget that this is still a Define - which means it is built around a gorgeous alloy frame with custom hydroformed tubes, hidden external cable routing, big bearings and radical geometry!
This frame is not just a fancy version of the Snabb - we worked hard to make sure we really are taking things to the next level. To start with, the industrial design was conceived by the guys who made the Eurobike Gold Award winning Rondo Ruut. It features unique semi-internal cable routing - the lines are elegantly hidden away, but there is none of the hassle that is involved with standard internal routing. The frame has adjustable geometry via adjustable and interchangeable shock mounts (it’s possible to change the height of the BB or even change the travel by swapping the shock and shock mounts). Big sealed pivots keep the frame stable and guarantee long periods of smooth, service free function. What we did take directly from the Snabb is the kinematics of the 4-bar suspension that everyone loves (Pinkbike: "There is so little pedal-induced bobbing at play here that it sort of boggles the mind”), progressive geometry and all-round fun factor.
MAIN FEATURES
- new alloy frame with custom hydroformed tubes & double pass welds,
- unique semi-internal cable routing
- modern aggressive geometry w/ long reach & slack angles
- designed for Enduro / mini DH riding
- 160 travel, 27.5” rear wheel compatibility
- travel and BB height can be adjusted via shockmount chipset
- FOX Performance Elite DPX2 LV Evol shock (small bump compliance, and more support the remaining travel)
- 1pcs rocker arm design
- you can completely transform the bike by changing the shock mount & shock (changes travel from 160 mm to 135
mm or vice versa).
